instruments.title: PCPD, Proper Handling of Data Access Request and Charging of Data Access Request Fee by Data Users

categoryRules.basis: Direct labour cost of locating and retrieving the requested data is directly related to and necessary for complying with the request.
categoryRules.verificationNote: Provisional pending the authoring lawyer's confirmation of §7.5's own 'directly related to and necessary for' characterisation of recoverable cost; printed as VERIFIED in the PRD extract.

categoryRules.basis: Reproduction cost at a standard per-page rate. Cap expressed in minor units (HK$1.50/page) and to be set by counsel against the entity's actual copying cost.
categoryRules.verificationNote: Per-page cap is an entity-specific figure and must not exceed actual direct cost. Confirm before activation.

matterFlagRules.message: A flat fee may be charged for administrative convenience provided it is lower than direct compliance costs and not excessive. Consider whether a flat fee is preferable to this itemisation.
The requestor must be told what fee, if any, will be charged as soon as practicable and in any event within 40 days of the request.

requestorNoticeTemplate: UNAUTHORED — counsel must author the requestor-facing fee notice for this jurisdiction before this pack can reach ACTIVE.
openQuestions: Apportionment method where a payroll vendor invoice covers more than the requested data.
Whether computer/system run time replacing manual labour is being claimed at cost.
Whether the entity's per-page rate reflects current actual cost.
constraints.noChargeForMakingRequest is set false — confirm there is no separate prohibition on charging for the act of making the request, as distinct from complying with it.

constraints.estimateRequiredBeforeCharging is set false while matterFlagRules requires notification of the fee within 40 days. Confirm whether the 40-day notification is, in substance, an estimate obligation; if so both fields should change together.

HK-PDPO.STAFF_TIME_LEGAL_REVIEW's basis replaces the phrase naming counsel's advice with 'advice from counsel' to avoid the banned word 'legal' (PD-5 i); the rule's substance — that this cost is not a cost of complying with the request — is unchanged. Counsel to confirm the reworded basis still reflects the intended position.

HK-PDPO.STAFF_TIME_REDACT_THIRD_PARTY's basis contains 'lawfully' (an adverbial inflection of the banned word 'lawful') that the canonical word-boundary matcher does not catch; the sentence ships verbatim per §7.5 and is flagged here for counsel (PD-5 ii).

appliesTo is printed in §7.5 as ['PRIVATE_ORGANISATION'] only, narrower than RulePackSchema's own documented derivation (the controller types whose posture is not PROHIBITED) — HK's PUBLIC_AGENCY posture is NO_EXPRESS_AUTHORITY, not PROHIBITED, so the derived rule would include it. Transcribed as printed per D-14; flagged for counsel to confirm which is correct (PD-5 iii).

flatFee.amount is committed as 0 — not a proposed or illustrative figure. §7.5 supplies no HK flat-fee figure, only the advisory HK.FLAT_FEE_CHECK matterFlagRule. verificationNote carries the UNAUTHORED token so the pack cannot reach ACTIVE while the figure is unset. Counsel must set the real figure before activation (PD-4).

flatFee.basis: No flat-fee figure is given in the source specification for this jurisdiction.
